$comment: The first non-synthetic ranker (docs/DEMO_DATA_PLAN_2026-09-03.md §7.1): Claude's own preference order over the catalog films it can judge, most loved first, written by judgment on 2026-09-03 and NOT derived from any fingerprint. Account claude@judge.local (outside @demo.local, so `make demo` never removes it). The app chose every triad (random-v1) and this order answered 75 of them (25 for §7.1, 25 more for §7.2 on 2026-09-03/04, 25 more for §7.3 on 2026-09-04); the rounds themselves live in the dev database under that profile (title uuids are per-database, so they are not committed).
